title: Laylo (YC S20) Is Hiring a Head of Finance
summary: Laylo, a Y Combinator Summer 2020 startup, is hiring a Head of Finance to lead financial operations and strategy as the company scales.
problem_solved: This job posting addresses Laylo's need for senior financial leadership to manage company growth and financial operations.
why_valuable: As a YC-backed startup, this role offers the opportunity to build financial infrastructure at an early-stage company with proven backing.
